topic: Realtime data display limitations and scope
summary_markdown:
The discussion centered on the real-time nature of a displayed metric (likely analytics). [p1] questioned the necessity of displaying this data continuously, suggesting it might be better to hide it until the end of the day. The participants acknowledged that while real-time display was intended as a 'super feature,' showing preliminary figures throughout the day can lead to excessive user questions and confusion regarding accuracy.

It was concluded that because the metric is calculated for the entire day, displaying incomplete data before the day ends is problematic.
decisions: The real-time display of the specific metric will be restricted or hidden until the end of the current business day.
